title: Reservation Cancellation and No-Show Terms, Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Terms of a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation, as they apply to the renter.**

(a) A reservation may be cancelled at no charge when the cancellation is made at least the class free-cancellation hours before the scheduled pickup date and time. A cancellation is free only when it is made not later than the scheduled pickup time minus the class free-cancellation hours. Hours are elapsed hours measured back from the scheduled pickup date and time.

(b) A later cancellation posts the class flat late cancellation fee. — This term is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the late cancellation fee.

(c) A reservation not picked up by the class no-show hours after the scheduled pickup time becomes a no-show and posts the class no-show fee.

(d) A reservation the facility cannot fill because no vehicle of the class is on the lot is cancelled without any fee.

The scheduled pickup date and time are those on the reservation record; the moment of cancellation is the cancellation date and time recorded on it.

## Cut-off cases (hypothetical reservation, scheduled pickup Saturday 09:00)

| Vehicle class | Free-cancellation hours | Cancelled at | Free under term (a) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 24 | Friday 09:00 | Yes — not later than pickup minus 24 hours |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 24 | Friday 09:01 | No |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 48 | Thursday 09:00 | Yes — not later than pickup minus 48 hours |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 48 | Thursday 09:01 | No |

## No-show case (same reservation, no-show point 2 hours)

The reservation is a no-show if the vehicle has not been picked up by 11:00 on Saturday, and the class no-show fee is then posted. Had the facility had no Bluegate Cargo Van on the lot to fill it, the reservation would instead be cancelled without any fee.
